payload.core_mechanism_summary: Slide a window of length |u| over s padded with non-matching characters, compute Hamming distance for each alignment, take minimum.
payload.rationale: The code iterates over all possible alignments of u on a padded version of s, computing the number of mismatches, which corresponds to the edit cost. This is essentially a sliding window exhaustive search, not an optimized amortized method, but the term sliding_window best fits the pattern among candidates.
